tools.curl: curl 8.5.0 (aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu) libcurl/8.5.0 OpenSSL/3.0.13 zlib/1.3 brotli/1.1.0 zstd/1.5.5 nghttp2/1.59.0

harness_change: nghttpd 1.70 no longer prints the `IPv4: listen 127.0.0.1:<port>` line that older releases emitted. The gate now waits through the Linux /proc/net/tcp{,6} LISTEN table instead of a TCP probe, because a probe would itself appear as an extra connection in nghttpd's one-connection transcript. Non-Linux hosts fall back to a short startup delay.
coverage: curl HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 against netz over cleartext and certificate-verified TLS
libcurl shared-library request/response trailers over HTTP/1.1 cleartext and TLS, including one easy-handle reuse
nghttp2 1.70 clients against netz HTTP/2 over h2c and TLS, with two concurrent POST streams, round-robin DATA, request trailers, response trailers and a static-file GET
netz HTTP/2 client against nghttpd 1.70 over h2c and certificate-verified TLS, with streams 1/3/5, terminal request trailers, echo bodies, response trailers and h2 ALPN on TLS
result: External HTTP interop passed in both endpoint roles: curl HTTP/1.1+h2, libcurl HTTP/1.1 trailers, and nghttp2 h2 clients against netz, plus netz h2 against nghttpd; cleartext and certificate-verified TLS, persistent H1 chunked and H2 multiplexed body/trailer traffic verified.
